title: Mapping from a constant coherent diagram is a limit of mapping spaces
statement: Use universes, small quasicategories, coherent functor categories, constant diagrams and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], coherent Hom bifunctors of [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality], and small limits of spaces of [lem-coef-infinity-yoneda-presheaf-limits]. Let $K$ and $E$ be small quasicategories, let $F:K\to E$ be a coherent functor, and let $z\in E$. Write $\Delta_K z$ for the constant diagram. Evaluation of a coherent transformation at the vertices and simplices of $K$ induces a natural equivalence of spaces $$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,E)}(\Delta_K z,F)\simeq\lim_{k\in K}\operatorname{Map}_E(z,F(k)).$$ The right-hand diagram is the composite of $F$ with the covariant coherent Hom functor $\operatorname{Map}_E(z,-)$. The equivalence retains all higher simplices, is natural in $z,F$, in postcomposition by functors $E\to E\prime$, and in restriction along functors $K\prime\to K$. Empty $K$ is allowed; its right side is the terminal space. No limits in $E$ are assumed.
